source: This creates a real trade-off. More registers per thread can keep useful temporaries and accumulators close to the arithmetic pipelines. But a larger register footprint can reduce the number of resident warps, which can reduce the pool of independent work available to hide stalls.
zh: 这造成了真正的权衡。每个线程更多的寄存器可以使有用的临时变量和累加器靠近算术管道。但较大的寄存器占用空间可以减少驻留扭曲的数量，从而减少可用于隐藏停顿的独立工作池。
